strings.en: Don't die on me too quickly.
I wonder how long I can play with you?
You're going to be my plaything.
I'll have plenty of fun with you.
Where should I hit you to make you squirm the most?
You're welcome to resist, you know?
With this Raftclans, you lot are nothing...!
You'll pay for making me angry...!
Don't think you'll get an easy death...!
Even without Larseilam,/　with the Raftclans...!
I can't afford/　to make any more mistakes...!
If not for a chance like this,/　I'd never get to play with a war hero.
Don't think you'll get an easy death,/　E-Selda Shune...!
You don't often get a chance/　to play with a Throne Unit.
I'll be the last opponent you ever face!
I'll take back the Granteed./　With your corpse still inside!
I'll get the Granteed no matter what!
If only I could use Larseilam,/　taking back the Throne Unit would be...!
If it comes to this,/　I'll take the Granteed by force...!
If I don't hold back, you'll break right away.
I'll give you despair like no other!
Capture me? That's a funny thing to say!
You lot... stay out of my way!
A new model, huh? Looks fun to break.
Dying in your first battle is an old story.
I like the sturdy ones./　I get to play with them for a long time.
I can't wait to see how long that bravado lasts.
I'll torment you nice and slow...!
If only you hadn't butted in...!
I don't like letting Earthlings/　use that thing.
A counterfeit that'll be fun to break.
Dress it up all you want, it's still a counterfeit.
Heh heh heh, I'll play with Vaula too.
Where do you think you're going?
I won't let you get away.
I'll have to thank you for that.
I don't let my prey escape.
Keep me company a little longer...!
How dare you... How dare you!
Y-You're kidding?! Like this?! Like thiiis!!
Honestly, this much resistance/　really ticks me off...!
I can't shake off someone like that...!
This is half fun, half infuriating...!
How dare scum like you do this to me...!
I can't even dodge the aim of someone like that...!
Ngh, if only I could use Larseilam...!
Trying so hard... Is your wound all right...?!
I want to break them... The Throne Unit, and you...!
Cornered by a mere test unit...!
Just a little more time, and you're finished!
You'd be useless without that sword...!
I'd rather have fought the Hückebein.
Tch, maybe I'll change how I play...!
It's no fun unless you can do that much.
You think that's got me cornered?
Well, I guess one-sided is boring anyway...
I can't afford any more mistakes...!
Don't get carried away, you lot...!
That's all you can do with a Throne Unit.../　How pathetic, E-Selda.
I could send you to join/　E-Selda, you know...?!
You half-dead wreck! Don't get cocky!
Its firepower and mobility have gone up...!
Don't get full of yourself, you counterfeit.
Heh heh heh, looks like I can play a long while.
I'd like you to try a little harder.
So much for the war hero.
Don't get cocky just because/　you're riding a Throne Unit...!
That new model.../　It does look fairly strong.
A mere test unit, darting around...!
Hah! Upgraded and that's all you've got?!
Isn't the Dygenguar supposed to be stronger?
You're trying hard, for a counterfeit.
You can't catch up to the Raftclans.
You'll capture me with that? What a joke!
That sort of thing doesn't work on me.
Wasted effort, that's what it is.
Guess I played around too much...
I'll save the fun for later.
You don't have to hide, you know.
No need to be so scared.
That's what you get for looking away!
This is how an Agent does it!
Heh heh heh, too scared to move?
I'll blast you with the Orgone Rifle!
You're in just the right spot!
Don't go calling me a coward!
I'll play with all of you at once!
